M01-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M01-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez ORDER BY COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M02-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr JOIN bm_param ON bm_param.param_schl = 'stat' WHERE bm_param.param_wert = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
M02-VAG: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE lfz.stat = 'active' GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl

M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST')

M03-VAG: SELECT COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug WHERE flugnr IN (SELECT flugnr FROM flug WHERE abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE bez = 'IST'))
M04-CAS: SELECT flghf.bez AS from, flghf.bez AS to, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.bez ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT flug.ank_ist, flug.abfl_ist, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flug JOIN flghf AS flghf_1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf_1.fh_nr JOIN flghf AS flghf_2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf_2.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf_1.iata_cd, flghf_2.iata_cd ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT flug_ladg.ladg_id, COUNT(flug_ladg.ladg_id) AS completed_flights FROM flug_ladg INNER JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flug_ladg.ladg_id ORDER BY completed_flights DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT flghf.bez AS departure, flghf.bez AS arrival, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.bez
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN flug.versp_cd IS NOT NULL THEN flug.versp_cd ELSE '0' END) AS avg_late_minutes FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT AVG((strftime('%s', flug.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', flug.ank_plan)) / 60) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(flug.versp_min) FROM flug INNER JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'

M06-SCH: SELECT flug.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flug JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY flug.bez ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC

M07-SCH: SELECT flges.bez, ROUND(SUM(betankg.co2_kg / 1000), 1) AS avg_co2_kg FROM flges INNER JOIN betankg ON flges.flges_nr = betankg.flug_id INNER JOIN flug ON betankg.flug_id = flug.flug_id INNER JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr
M07-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2 FROM flges JOIN betankg ON flges.flges_nr = betankg.flges_nr GROUP BY flges.bez
M07-VAG: SELECT flug.flugnr, SUM(betankg.co2_kg) AS total_co2_emissions FROM flug JOIN betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flug.flugnr
M08-CAS: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-SCH: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-BIZ: SELECT flghf.reg, AVG(betankg.preis_usd_l) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.flug_id = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.reg
M08-VAG: SELECT AVG(betankg.menge_kg) FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.fh_nr = betankg.fh_nr

M09-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.flaeche_m2 >= 4000
M09-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS warehouse_count FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort

M10-SCH: SELECT flghf.iata_cd, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr WHERE lgr.zolllager_kz = 1 GROUP BY flghf.ort
M10-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flghf.bez, COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) AS bonded_warehouses FROM flghf JOIN lgr ON flghf.fh_nr = lgr.fh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort, flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(lgr.lgr_nr) > 1

H01-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf INNER JOIN lfz ON flghf.fh_nr = lfz.heimat_fh_nr INNER JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.bez, lfz.kennz ORDER BY COUNT(flug.flug_id) DESC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT flges.bez, lfz.kennz, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges INNER JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr INNER JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flges.flges_nr
H01-VAG: SELECT flges.bez, lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(sndg.sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM flges JOIN lfz_typ ON flges.flges_nr = lfz_typ.flges_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr GROUP BY flges.flges_nr
H02-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS landing_count FROM flghf JOIN flges ON flghf.flh_nr = flges.hub_fh_nr JOIN flug ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.flh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
H02-SCH: SELECT flghf.bez, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.flh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN flges ON flug.flugnr = flges.flugnr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd
H02-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM flghf JOIN flges ON flghf.icao_cd = flges.icao_cd JOIN flug ON flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank
H02-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count FROM flghf JOIN flges ON flghf.flh_nr = flges.hub_fh_nr JOIN flug ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.flh_nr GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
H03-CAS: SELECT rech_kopf.ausst_dat, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced FROM rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025-%' GROUP BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat
H03-SCH: SELECT rech_kopf.ausst_dat, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd), SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY rech_kopf.ausst_dat) FROM rech_kopf WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025%'
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS monthly_revenue FROM rech_kopf JOIN flug ON rech_kopf.sndg_nr = flug.sndg_nr JOIN sndg ON flug.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE rech_kopf.ausst_dat LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(zahlg.betr_usd) AS total_revenue FROM rech_kopf JOIN zahlg ON rech_kopf.rech_id = zahlg.rech_id WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = strftime('%Y', CURRENT_DATE)
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(sdg_verfolg.ereig_id) AS flights_completed, AVG(sdg_verfolg.gew_kg) AS avg_weight FROM flug INNER JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flug.flug_id = sdg_verfolg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan)
H04-SCH: SELECT flug.abfl_ist, flug.stat, LAG(COUNT(CASE WHEN flug.stat = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END)) OVER (ORDER BY flug.abfl_ist) - COUNT(CASE WHEN flug.stat = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS diff FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_plan)
H04-VAG: SELECT flug.abfl_plan, COUNT(flug_id) FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf fh_nr GROUP BY flug.abfl_plan
H05-CAS: SELECT AVG(betankg.betank_zeit - betankg.menge_kg / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg * 60) FROM lfz JOIN betankg ON lfz.lfz_nr = betankg.lfz_nr JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND betankg.stat = 'completed'
H05-SCH: SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG((strftime('%s', flug.abfl_ist) - strftime('%s', flug.ank_ist)) / 3600) AS avg_time_diff FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lfz.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(flug.abfl_ist - flug.abfl_plan) FROM lfz AS lfz JOIN flug AS flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN betankg AS betankg ON flug.flug_id = betankg.flug_id JOIN rech_kopf AS rech_kopf ON flug.flug_id = rech_kopf.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
H05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flug.flug_id) FROM flug INNER JOIN sdg_verfolg ON flug.flug_id = sdg_verfolg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'ARR'
H06-CAS: SELECT COUNT(kunnr) AS customer_count, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.kunnr HAVING COUNT(kunnr) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(kunnr) FROM knd_stamm) > 4
H06-SCH: SELECT AVG(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) * 100 FROM sndg INNER JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr WHERE knd_stamm.name1 IN (SELECT name1 FROM knd_stamm WHERE treue_stufe IN ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'platinum') AND kredlim_usd > 4000)
H06-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.kto_cd, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS revenue, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) * 100 AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr WHERE revenue > 4 ORDER BY revenue DESC
H06-VAG: SELECT COUNT(kunnr) AS key_accounts, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS total_revenue FROM knd_stamm INNER JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr
H07-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(betankg.fracht_gew_kg) as total_cargo FROM flghf JOIN betankg ON flghf.flh_nr = betankg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flug.ort, COUNT(sndg.sndg_nr) AS count, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnage FROM flug JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf fh_nr JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' GROUP BY flug.ort ORDER BY tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN sndg ON flghf.flug_id = sndg.urspr_fh GROUP BY flghf.flug_id ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.fh_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.ort
H08-CAS: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(flug_id) FROM lfz_typ JOIN flug ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = flug.typ_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.lade_folge = 1 AND sndg.waren_vol_m3 * 167 < flug_ladg.lade_folge * flug_ladg.lade_folge * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 / 2 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-SCH: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) as completed_flights FROM lfz_typ JOIN lfz ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND SUM(flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3) > 0.5 * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-BIZ: SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(flug_id) FROM lfz_typ INNER JOIN lfz ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = lfz.typ_nr INNER JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr INNER JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.uld_typ = 'PAG' AND (flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3 / lfz_typ.max_vol_m3) > 0.5 GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
H08-VAG: SELECT AVG(sndg.fracht_gew_kg / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg) AS avg_fill_rate FROM lfz_typ JOIN sndg ON lfz_typ.typ_nr = sndg.typ_nr WHERE sndg.fracht_gew_kg / lfz_typ.max_nutzl_kg >= 0.5
H09-CAS: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lfz.kennz) FROM flghf JOIN lfz ON flghf.hub_kz = lfz.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL
H09-SCH: SELECT COUNT(lfz.kennz) FROM flghf JOIN lfz ON flghf.fh_nr = lfz.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flghf.hub_kz = 1 AND flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug.ziel_fh = flghf.fh_nr
H09-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(lfz.kennz) FROM lfz JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf.fh_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flghf.hub_kz = 1
H09-VAG: SELECT COUNT(lfz.kennz) FROM lfz INNER JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_anm.zoll_land, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) FROM zoll_anm INNER JOIN knd_stamm ON zoll_anm.kunnr = knd_stamm WHERE zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct > 20
H10-SCH: SELECT COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) FROM zoll_anm INNER JOIN zoll_land ON zoll_anm.zoll_land = zoll_land.zoll_land WHERE zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd > 0.2 * zollwert_usd
H10-BIZ: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) FROM zoll_anm JOIN zoll_land ON zoll_anm.zoll_land = zoll_land WHERE zoll_anm.zollsatz_pct > 20 GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-VAG: SELECT COUNT(zoll_anm.zollwert_usd) FROM bm_param INNER JOIN zoll_anm ON bm_param.param_schl = 'high_tax_countries' WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'import'
